observations: Photo 0 shows a black standing fan with a circular wire cage, five blades, and a black base. The fan is on a tiled floor against a white wall. A power cord is visible on the floor.
Photo 1 shows the same fan from a slightly different angle, with the brand name 'QASA' visible on the center hub of the fan head. The fan is still on the floor, and the power cord is visible.
The fan appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust on the base and blades. No visible damage to the cage or blades.
The seller claims it is a rechargeable fan, lasts up to 2 hours on full charge, and longer on low speed.

claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: Brand 'QASA' is visible on the fan head in photo 1. The item is clearly a standing fan, and the seller's description matches the item.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low.
claims.evidence: No photo shows the fan in operation or any indicator of battery life. The claim cannot be verified from the photos alone.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The fan may not be rechargeable as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the charging port, battery indicator, or a video of the fan being charged and operating on battery power.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-rechargeable, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The fan may not work or may have motor issues.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the fan turning on, oscillating, and operating at different speeds.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which reduces value to scrap or parts.

risks.risk: The fan may have hidden damage or wear not visible in photos, such as bent blades or loose parts.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the blades and motor housing, and a video of the fan in operation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential hidden damage, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Video of the fan turning on and operating at different speeds.
Photo of the charging port and battery indicator if it is rechargeable.
Close-up photo of the blades and motor housing to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
